name: Lawflow
tagline: The AI-powered law office, connected to the State.
summary: AI for law firms: research, drafting and case management, integrated with Greek and EU public-sector systems.
description:
Lawflow is an AI platform built for Greek law firms and legal departments. It brings case management, legal research, document drafting and deadlines into one place.

Lawflow connects directly to the Greek and European public-sector systems lawyers use every day, so less time goes on admin and more on practising law.

features.title: AI legal research

features.title: Document drafting and review

features.title: Case and matter management
features.text: Clients, cases, documents, hearings and billing in one workspace.

features.title: Deadline intelligence
features.text: Automatic calculation and reminders for procedural deadlines and court dates.

features.title: Public-sector integration
features.text: Retrieve data and file documents through official Greek and EU systems without retyping.

name: CoffeeAnalytics
summary: Measure every serving, forecast demand and protect supply across the venues you serve.
description:
CoffeeAnalytics measures every serving poured in the venues a beverage supplier serves, and turns it into sales, stock and forecasting intelligence.

A compact device fits to professional espresso machines, beer taps and postmix dispensers and records each pour as it happens. Suppliers see consumption, stock and forecasts for every venue on the web or on their phone. The venue's staff don't need to change how they work.

features.title: Live consumption tracking
features.text: Every serving is logged per group, tap or valve, replacing estimates based on invoices.

features.title: Customer stock estimates
features.text: Recorded deliveries minus measured servings show how many days of product each venue has left.

features.title: Supplier protection
features.text: Compares measured consumption with deliveries and flags product that came from another supplier.

features.title: Sales dashboard
features.text: Volume, turnover, margin, quarterly targets and per-rep performance.

features.title: Daily rep lists and routing
features.text: Which customers need a delivery, who is ordering later than usual, and routes based on real consumption.

features.title: AI forecasting
features.text: Per-machine forecasts based on history, the same season last year, weather and public holidays.

features.title: Venue tools
features.text: Peak-hour charts, weekly forecasts and suggested staffing for busy periods.

features.title: Geomarketing
features.text: A consumption map by street and neighbourhood that shows untapped areas and compares sites.

steps.title: Fit the device
steps.text: A technician installs it in minutes on espresso machines, beer taps or postmix dispensers.

steps.title: Measure every serving
steps.text: Up to 4 groups per machine, encrypted, with offline buffering.

steps.title: Compare and forecast
steps.text: The platform subtracts consumption from deliveries and forecasts demand.

steps.title: Act on the data
steps.text: Reps and management get daily lists, dashboards and alerts.

highlights: Zero changes to how the venue works
One platform for management, sales, marketing and service
No software to install and no staff training
